entities.name: Bernardine Monastery, Iziaslav
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Monastery of St. Michael and Bernardine is a former Roman Catholic monastery complex in Iziaslav, Ukraine, that was built in the early 17th century. The complex is used as a prison, Zamkova Correctional Colony No. 58. The buildings are an example of Baroque architecture in Ukraine.
